---
description: "Semantic line breaks and documentation accuracy for Markdown."
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Markdown conventions

Use semantic line breaks at sentence and useful clause boundaries.
Preserve paragraph separation, tables, lists, frontmatter, and code blocks.
Do not rewrap inline code or change examples merely to enforce line length.

Keep CLI examples consistent with `gh-updater --help`.
Use relative links to repository files.
Document only implemented behavior and real workflow triggers.
Separate user tasks, CLI reference, design rationale, and contributor guidance;
link existing pages rather than duplicating them.
